clips.title: The story
paras: In the poisoned halls of Gnomeregan, troggs and leper gnomes roam among broken defenses. Once the gnomes’ subterranean capital, it fell after a desperate defense turned to catastrophe.

Gnomeregan’s halls once rang with the work of gnomish engineers. Built with aid from the Ironforge dwarves centuries ago, the city was carved into the snowy crags of western Dun Morogh. Steam-driven gears, copper piping, and vast assembly halls made it the heart of gnomish industry and invention. During the Second War, its designs, flying machines, and complex armaments supplied the Alliance. The city held firm even as Orgrim Doomhammer’s Horde laid siege.

During the Third War, troggs surged from deep underground and broke into Gnomeregan’s lowest chambers. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque chose to face the invasion alone, unwilling to draw Alliance armies away from the slaughter in Lordaeron. On the advice of chief engineer Mekgineer Thermaplugg, he ordered radioactive gas released through the lower chambers to wipe out the troggs. Instead, the gas empowered many of them and killed nearly eighty percent of the gnomish people. Those exposed who survived became twisted leper gnomes, and Thermaplugg took control of the poisoned ruins.
